risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed, particularly on credit-loss provisions, charge-offs, balance-sheet measures, and interest-rate data, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and broad uncertainty language. COVID-19 created material downside risk through potential deterioration in asset quality, higher provisions, deferred borrower payments, margin compression, and possible insufficiency of estimates if economic conditions worsened.
